{{Top}}
'''Aeien silk''' was a fabric often used in [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] owned a [[Cape/Legends|cape]] lined with aeien silk.
